subject: Pilot onboarding: alternative invoice-only path for ClearPath
messages:
From: Susan Park <susan.park@clearpathlogistics.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: ap@clearpathlogistics.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding: billing without PO?

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed. We want to kick off a 6‑week pilot to integrate Redwood for inbound routing, but our AP runs on a consolidated invoicing flow and we typically don't issue a PO for pilots under $10k. Can you confirm whether Redwood requires a PO to process invoices, or if there is a temporary invoice-only path for trials?

I'm attaching our W9 and a short vendor intake form. If you need other paperwork, tell me what to send and we'll prioritize it.

Best,
Susan Park
Procurement Lead | ClearPath Logistics
attachments: W9_ClearPath.pdf, vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

From: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@clearpathlogistics.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding: billing without PO?

Susan — thanks for sending over the docs and for the quick follow-up. Short answer: our standard procurement process is PO-required for vendor payments, but we do have an established temporary invoice-only route for short pilots and proof-of-concepts under certain conditions.

Conditions we typically require for invoice-only pilots:
- Completed vendor onboarding form + W9 (received)
- Proof of insurance or indemnity for services (we'll need certificate)
- Spend cap pre-approved by Finance (we'll need a spend threshold)
- AP routing instructions (who will receive invoice, remittance address)
- Agreement or signed SOW that references pilot scope and payment terms

I've looped in Neha from Procurement to evaluate operating risk and document the exception. If Finance signs off on a capped invoice-only pilot, Procurement will log an exception and set an expiration (typically 45–90 days) after which a PO is required for further invoices.

Next steps I propose:
1) Neha runs a quick risk check (insurance, tax docs).
2) Marissa (Sales) helps confirm pilot scope and an internal champion so Finance can set a dollar cap.
3) If approved, Finance will confirm AP routing and the temporary approval window.

Neha — can you take the risk checklist and advise what gaps ClearPath needs to fill? I'll coordinate with Finance for the cap.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
redwood.com

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@clearpathlogistics.com>, aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding: billing without PO?

Hi Susan — great to e-meet. We want to move quickly on this pilot; proposing a 30‑day invoice-only pilot capped at $15,000 while we validate integration and latency SLAs. If we hit that cap or want to continue, we'll convert to a PO-backed contract.

I attached a short mutual action plan (MAP) link in the drive folder that lays out milestones and acceptance criteria — helps speed procurement/finance sign-off.

Aisha/Neha — can Finance confirm if $15k is a workable pilot cap? If so, we can issue a cover email to AP with timeline and acceptance criteria.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: (see drive link)

From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding: billing without PO?

Quick note from Finance:
- We can approve a temporary invoice-only pilot up to $15,000 total spend.
- Approval contingent on: completed onboarding form, W9, certificate of insurance (COI) naming Redwood as additional insured, and a signed SOW that includes payment terms net 30.
- Exception will be logged in our procurement tracker and will expire 60 days after approval; after that a PO is required.
- Invoices should be emailed to ap@redwood.com and must include "Pilot: ClearPath" in the subject and invoice reference.

Neha — please confirm once you have the COI and onboarding form validated and I'll issue the finance confirmation email for AP.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
